thread:
amal: heads-up — after landing the torch.compile + autotune change on nightly I’m seeing a 12-18% p99 tail latency regression for llm-13b at seq_len 2048-4096 :eyes:
amal: repro: curl -X POST ... --data '{"model":"llm-13b","seq_len":4096,"batch":1,"compile":true,"autotune":true}'
infra-bot: deploy completed: autotune/2026-03-15-nightly (hash: a1b2c3)
kevin: can you paste a quick profiler snapshot (cuda kernels, time per op)? also which cudagraphs mode are we using (static/dynamic)?
amal: pasted minimal repro and profiler below:
amal: ```
# runtime config
model: llm-13b
seqs: [512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
batch: 1
compile: true
cudagraphs: enabled (static)
autotune: enabled
```
amal: profiler excerpt (avg over 20 requests):
```
GPU total kernel time: 38.2ms -> baseline (no-compile+no-cudagraphs) 32.5ms
Kernel breakdown:
 - flash_attn_fwd_64x64: 12.6ms
 - fwd_attn_small_bsz: 8.1ms (new pick)
 - gelu_cuda: 4.2ms
 - kv_cache_write: 2.3ms (spikes when compile+static-cg reuse fails)
```
kevin: interesting — looks like autotune picked fwd_attn_small_bsz for certain shape/seq combos. that + static cudagraph reuse failing would increase kernel launches and memcpy churn
sophie: fyi torch.compile can change how shapes are traced which leads to different shapegraphs. when static cuDAGraphs are used, a shape mismatch forces a fallback path that replays kernels without the cudagraph leading to higher tail.
sophie: in our last run the compile+autotune combo picked kernel variant A for seq<=1024 and variant B for 2048+, but cudagraphs baked the smaller-variant graph so longer seqs fell back to slow path
raj: dumped autotune/select log:
```
[autotune] seq=1024 -> select kernel=flash_attn_64x64 (score=0.98)
[autotune] seq=2048 -> select kernel=fwd_attn_small_bsz (score=1.02)
[autotune] seq=4096 -> select kernel=fwd_attn_small_bsz (score=1.01)
```
kevin: can you rerun with cudagraphs=dynamic (or disabled) and compile=true to isolate whether static-cg reuse is the main culprit? also run compile=false + cudagraphs=enabled to see autotune-only effect
amal: running three runs now: (1) compile=true cudagraphs=static (nightly, regression) (2) compile=true cudagraphs=dynamic (3) compile=false cudagraphs=static
amal: initial quick numbers:
 - (1) p99 198ms, gpu kernel time 38.2ms
 - (2) p99 172ms, gpu kernel time 33.4ms
 - (3) p99 169ms, gpu kernel time 32.8ms
maria: sounds like two issues colliding: (A) compile changes traces -> different kernel picks from autotune (B) static cudagraphs assumption about fixed shapes causes costly fallbacks when trace shapes change or kv-cache miss pattern differs
maria: suggestion: runtime defensive heuristic — if compile is enabled, prefer kernel picks with stable shape coverage (slightly lower perf but less fallback risk). also detect high kv_cache_miss rate and temporarily disable static-cg for that session
sophie: agree. we can add a small autotune cost model term penalizing variants with narrow shape coverage when dynamic-shape mode is on
kevin: another quick experiment: force kernel=fallback_stable (override) and run with compile+static-cg, to confirm autotune variant is root cause
amal: forced stable kernel run: p99 170ms, gpu time 33.0ms — basically recovers to pre-change levels. so autotune pick + static-cg interplay is the combo that regressed perf
raj: filing a tiny autotune change: add shape_coverage_score and a flag --prefer-stable-kernels. will test across seq grid
kevin: can we also add a runtime opt: if cudagraphs static reuse falls back more than X% in last N requests, auto-disable static cg for that model/version
maria: +1 for runtime fallback guard. also add prometheus metric: cg_reuse_failures{model,version,host} so we can alert before tail explodes
amal: action items: (1) raj to prototype shape_coverage_score + prefer-stable flag (2) infra to add cg_reuse_failures metric (3) amal to run full grid and post numbers (4) revert autotune commit if regression persists in canary :thumbsup:
kevin: I’ll own rollout gating for autotune changes — please tag me when you have a candidate change
amal: thanks — will update thread with full run tomorrow. cc @kevin @raj @sophie :+1:
